verdict.rationale: Puzzle's AI Close is documented as using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies during month-end close. Separate docs describe matching invoices to payments and flagging receivables before close, with the user reviewing before anything is final. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the end-to-end AI Close workflow (bank transaction matching steps, exception handling, close sign-off package), independent or hands-on corroboration that agents complete a full month close.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: AI Close helps you automate and accelerate your month-end process using AI agents to reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies.
matching invoices to payments, pulling together what your accountant needs — described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
finds the payments that most likely pay your open invoices, and flags the receivables that need attention before you close the month
